subject: Request: short customer quotes for enterprise sales kit
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightlayer.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-12T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: short customer quotes for enterprise sales kit

Hi Elena —

Hope you're well. We're updating our enterprise sales kit (one-pager + 2-slide customer highlight) and would love to include a one-liner quote and a short metric from BrightLayer about the impact of Redwood Inference.

Specifically we'd ask for: 1) a 10–18 word quote we can put on a slide, and 2) one data point (e.g., latency reduction, cost savings, throughput increase) you’re comfortable citing. We'll also include your logo and a short credit line (name + title).

If you’re open to this, can you (or contracts@brightlayer.io) confirm any internal approvals needed? We can provide a short draft for sign-off to speed things up.

Attachments: none on this message.

Thanks so much — appreciate your help.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Field Enablement | Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightlayer.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@brightlayer.io
Date: 2027-06-12T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short customer quotes for enterprise sales kit

Hi Hannah,

Thanks and congrats on the new kit — happy to help. I've pulled a couple of suggested lines below and attached a short testimonial PDF plus our logo. Legal copied here for a quick review; we typically just need a one-sentence sign-off.

Suggested quote (feel free to edit): "Redwood Inference cut our inference latency by 3x while reducing GPU spend by ~40% — enabling faster product experiments." — Elena Rossi, Head of Data Platforms

Metric for slide: "3x median latency improvement; ~40% reduction in cost-per-token over prior serving setup" (measured over Q1–Q2 2027)

Attached: BrightLayer_Testimonial.pdf, brightlayer_logo.png

Contracts, please advise if a written sign-off is sufficient, or if we need an executed MSA amendment for logo/quote use.

Best,
Elena
VP, Data & Platforms | BrightLayer

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-13T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short customer quotes for enterprise sales kit

Looping the enablement + content folks. Elena already gave a tight quote and attached assets — great timing. Monica, can you slot the quote + metric into the one-pager and the two-slide highlight (slide 1: problem + solution; slide 2: impact + quote + brightlayer logo)? Connor, can you pre-fill the HubSpot quote card and link the Drive assets so AE Rachel can use them in the playbook?

I’ll draft two micro-variants of the quote (one formal, one punchy) for legal sign-off. We should aim to have final slides + copy by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: copied from Elena (BrightLayer_Testimonial.pdf, brightlayer_logo.png)

— Marissa
Senior Content Strategist | Redwood Inference

Hi all,

Legal here — confirmed. BrightLayer approves the suggested quote and logo usage. A brief written email approval is sufficient; no MSA amendment required for marketing use in one-pagers and sales collateral. Please attribute the quote to Elena Rossi, VP, Data & Platforms.

We request a final proof for records; please send a PDF of the slide(s) before public distribution.

Thanks,
